sources.method: Transformed every WGS84 ring vertex using project formula X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; subtracted manifest placement [-288,-570] for local coordinates. Compared GIS ring with top perimeter vertices of evaluated HANS_StructuralSlab_Basement mesh.
sources.uncertainty: ArcGIS polygon is a campus building-shape representation, not a surveyed wall line; source capture date is not exposed in attributes. Project conversion is local approximate geographic conversion, not a formal projected/survey CRS.

sources.provider: Purdue University Building Emergency Plan (HANS BEP)
supports: listed occupied levels: basement and floors 1 through 4; labs, offices, conference and support use
sources.uncertainty: Emergency plan identifies floor access and occupancy but does not provide as-built facade elevations or reliable architectural dimensions. Its five occupied floor levels plus basement label differ from GIS NUM_LEVELS/CountOfFLO=6 in categorization; model keeps a basement plus four above-grade floor plates.
sources.availability_note: The official Purdue URL is indexed with the PDF text, but the source server returned a Page Not Found page when fetched on 2026-10-27. Facts are retained as an indexed source reference; no raw PDF snapshot is included.

sources.provider: Purdue University Events Calendar (photo attached to HANS location page)

supports: current-ish exterior visual cross-check; image captioned Hansen Life Sciences Building
sources.uncertainty: User-posted image on Purdue-hosted calendar, not an authoritative measured elevation or design record; source image is not redistributed in repo.

supports: timeline says Hansen Life Sciences Building completion in 1984
sources.uncertainty: This conflicts with the archive entity record existence date 1983 and manifest completion year 1983. Completion year should remain unresolved.

comparison.method_caveat: Near-perfect agreement is expected because source GIS appears to have informed the asset; it is an internal geometry consistency check, not independent evidence of surveyed wall placement. Decorative site geometry was excluded.

geometry_and_portability.textures: Materials are authored within the blend. Fresh-open dependency inspection found no external images or linked libraries.
geometry_and_portability.fresh_open_validation: Opened source blend in a new background Blender 5.2.3 process, evaluated structural slab mesh, generated preview_oblique.png.

dimensions.height: GIS attributes Extrution=60 and R=67 (units not explicitly labelled by service); BEP confirms basement and levels 1-4. Asset modeled base/main roof deck at z=17.5m, parapet/penthouse roof to 20.572m, roof exhaust stacks to z=24.147m. Exact finished grade-to-roof height remains unverified; do not treat GIS numbers or modeled rooftop equipment as measured elevation.

interior_limitation: Official Purdue GIS floorplans point to a restricted internal server path. The emergency plan is not an as-built plan. Interior lab/room layouts remain unmodeled/unverified; no room arrangement is claimed.
remaining_uncertainties: No authoritative as-built facade elevations/section were found.
GIS vertical attribute units and datum meaning are not documented in exposed layer schema.

Official description calls it four stories; GIS records six levels/60 extrusion and the BEP identifies basement plus floors 1-4. Basement grade relationship and actual roof height need survey or official elevations.
Window bay rhythm, brick/precast colors, entrance canopy/courtyard relationships and rooftop equipment positions lack a published elevation/photo set with multiple documented views.
Interior layout is unavailable outside restricted Purdue internal CAD.
Purdue sources conflict on completion year (1983 archive entity record versus 1984 campus timeline).

independent_grade.summary: FID 237 plan matches with IoU 0.999999 and symmetric Hausdorff distance 0.000030 m; roof/height, level conflict and facade evidence remain uncertain.
